title: Image Typology V2 Level 3 class - Visual content type
description: Classification value from Level 3 of the Image Typology V2 taxonomy. Classifies the form, structure, and representational characteristics of the visual content.

oneOf.title: Caricature or Editorial cartoon or Humoristic drawing
oneOf.description: A single humorous, satirical, or exaggerated drawing, including editorial cartoons and caricatures.

oneOf.title: Comic strip
oneOf.description: A sequence of two or more illustrated panels, typically with dialogue inside speech bubbles.

oneOf.title: Game
oneOf.description: A printed puzzle, riddle, crossword, board-game layout, or other recreational game-related illustration.

oneOf.title: Graph
oneOf.description: A visual representation of data, such as a bar chart, line graph, pie chart, or statistical plot.

oneOf.title: Human representations - Fashion visual
oneOf.description: A depiction focused on clothing, accessories, or fashion trends, including fashion sketches and photographs of models.

oneOf.title: Human representations - Portrait
oneOf.description: A close-up depiction centred on an individual person, including formal portraits, profiles, and artistic renderings.

oneOf.title: Human representations - Scene
oneOf.description: A depiction of people interacting, undertaking activities, or forming part of a larger scene or crowd.

oneOf.title: Illustrated story
oneOf.description: A narrative illustration accompanying a serialized story, usually with prose narration rather than dialogue bubbles.

oneOf.title: Map - Geological map
oneOf.description: A map showing rock formations or geological features, such as faults, folds, and geological units.

oneOf.title: Map - Geopolitical map
oneOf.description: A map emphasizing territorial boundaries, political divisions, and place names.

oneOf.title: Map - Physical map or Roadmap
oneOf.description: A physical map showing natural features or a roadmap showing transport routes and networks.

oneOf.title: Map - Plan
oneOf.description: A detailed, scaled plan of a specific place, building, district, or infrastructure layout.

oneOf.title: Map - Weather map
oneOf.description: A map depicting meteorological conditions, such as temperature, precipitation, cloud cover, wind, or atmospheric pressure.

oneOf.title: Non-figurative visual content
oneOf.description: A visual content composed primarily of stylised text, often used in advertisements.

oneOf.title: Object
oneOf.description: A depiction centred on a discrete object rather than a person, scene, map, or other defined visual type.

oneOf.title: Ornament or Illustrated Title
oneOf.description: An ornamental or illustrated section title, potentially combining decorative lettering, figurative elements, or abstract embellishment.

oneOf.title: Other
oneOf.description: A visual content that cannot be assigned to any other available class.

oneOf.title: Scenery or Landscape
oneOf.description: A depiction of a natural landscape, cityscape, or environmental scene in which people are not the main subject.

oneOf.title: Technical drawing
oneOf.description: A precise technical diagram, such as an architectural blueprint, engineering schematic, or mechanical drawing.

oneOf.title: Weather infographic
oneOf.description: A non-geographical infographic representing weather conditions through charts, symbols, or meteorological indicators.

oneOf.title: Undetermined
oneOf.description: The classification could not be determined, or does not apply at this level.
